title: Skipped HEIF grid tiles can deadlock parallel decoding
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not specified for this finding)
summary: A skipped invalid tile left an empty queue entry that was dispatched as item ID 0, potentially deadlocking parallel decoding.
ai_role: The item-level libheif advisory explicitly attributes discovery to Anthropic's OSS Scanner as ANT-2026-OTCOV03Y. The release notes independently state that all listed security issues were found by the scanner. The Anthropic program sources establish model-based scanning, but no per-case model is identified.
classification_note: The primary advisory establishes a publicly disclosed security finding and direct Anthropic OSS Scanner attribution. No CVE had been assigned in the libheif release notes at the checked time; the distinct GHSA is used. No exploitation or zero-day status is asserted.
remediation_note: The queue now distinguishes empty entries from valid item ID 0 and skips empty jobs. Fixed in libheif 1.23.7. The libheif v1.23.7 security release is dated 2026-10-26; deployed patch status is not checked.
